 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The non-background motif is reflected horizontally into the zero placeholder.
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    motif = [grid[r][c0:c1+1] for r in range(r0, r1+1)]
    zeros = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]
    z0, z1 = min(r for r, c in zeros), max(r for r, c in zeros)
    q0, q1 = min(c for r, c in zeros), max(c for r, c in zeros)
    for dr in range(z1-z0+1):
        for dc in range(q1-q0+1):
            out[z0+dr][q0+dc] = motif[dr][-(dc+1)]
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test = [[8]*12 for _ in range(12)]
    test[1][1:5]=[1,1,1,2]; test[2][1:5]=[1,1,2,1]; test[3][1:5]=[1,2,2,2]
    for r in range(9,12): test[r][2:6]=[0]*4
    print(transform(test))

# Demo check: horizontal reflection of the source's 4x4 motif reproduces the demonstrated output pattern.
# (Demo's motif was rows 1-4, columns 1-4; its destination was rows 7-10, columns 4-7.)
# Source transformation is applied to every row, including the background-colored border row only if in motif bbox.
def _demo_check():
    src = [[1,3,3,1],[1,1,3,1],[1,3,3,3],[1,1,1,1]]
    expected = [[1,3,3,1],[1,3,1,1],[3,3,3,1],[1,1,1,1]]
    assert [row[::-1] for row in src] == expected
_demo_check()
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
